summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the title sequence formatter "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor (terminal check only); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skips on legacy Windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only, mocked wrapper). Nothing was committed, and no tests, scripts, or repository code were run, so the work is verified by reading only. Black and mypy were not run.
